outcome: Types of ureteric injury (ureteric obstruction, ureterovaginal fistula)
cohort: The study included 116 patients (median age 49 years, range 23-88 years) who were referred for management of vesicovaginal fistula between 2004 and 2016.
finding: Ureteric injury was found in 3.4% of patients presenting with vesicovaginal fistula, which is less common than previously reported, and was successfully managed with simultaneous reimplantation or primary diversion.
